C0596.title: State-Owned Enterprise Employee Coerced into Espionage Abroad, Leaking Classified Information
C0596.summary: The Ministry of State Security WeChat account disclosed that Li Si, a key-position employee at a state-owned enterprise, was trapped, threatened, and recruited by a foreign spy organization during an overseas visit after personal misconduct, and handed over classified information on the spot. Nearly ten years of classified materials from a classified computer fell into the hands of the foreign spy organization, and Li was eventually arrested according to law. The incident exposed the risk of classified materials or state secret information leakage when employees are coerced through personal conduct.
